name: board
description: A living board per session: /board asks a model to rewrite the list of what is done, what is pending and what waits on your decision from this session's conversation, and keeps it in a file under the project.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that rewrites the board: an alias such as haiku or a full model id.

reminderTurns.title: Reminder turns
reminderTurns.description: How many of your turns may pass with pending board items and no board tool call before Claude is reminded in one line.
